title: The Popol Vuh: Creation and Maize
goal: Tell the order of events in the Popol Vuh with antes de and después de + infinitive.
grammar: antes de and después de + infinitive

sections.title: The Popol Vuh: Creation and Maize
body: In this lesson you read about the Popol Vuh, a K'iche' book of the highlands of Guatemala, and its story of how the world and people were made.
The grammar is the one you know for putting events in order: *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive, and *cuando* + subjunctive for the future.

items: I can say what came first and what came next with *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive.
I can tell in outline how the gods created people in the Popol Vuh.
I can explain how the Popol Vuh reached us today.
